table_of_contents.text: When to Reset Your Frigidaire Fridge
Two Methods to Reset Your Frigidaire Fridge
1. Use the Reset Button or Crush Button on Your Frigidaire Fridge
2. Turn Off the Circuit Breaker for Your Frigidaire Fridge

content_sections.heading: When to Reset Your Frigidaire Fridge

items.text: After a Power Surge: Power outages or electrical surges can sometimes disrupt the normal functioning of electronic appliances like refrigerators. Resetting the fridge can help restore it to normal operation after such events.
Error Code Displayed: If your fridge displays error codes indicating a malfunction, resetting it can clear these codes and potentially resolve the underlying issue.
Temperature Issues: If your fridge is not cooling or freezing properly, resetting it can help recalibrate the temperature settings and resolve the issue.
Control Panel Malfunction: Sometimes, the control panel on your fridge may freeze or malfunction, causing it to stop responding to commands. Resetting the fridge can often fix this problem.

content_sections.heading: Two Methods to Reset Your Frigidaire Fridge
1. Use the Reset Button or Crush Button on Your Frigidaire Fridge

content.text: First, check if your fridge has a Reset button on the control panel at the front of the fridge. Once you have located it, press and hold the button for 5 seconds. If there is no Reset button, press and hold the Crush button for 5 seconds instead. You may see lights flashing on the control panel flash or hear a beeping as the fridge returns to its default settings. Once the reset process is complete, monitor how your refrigerator is performing over the next few hours to ensure that it is functioning properly again.

content_sections.heading: 2. Turn Off the Circuit Breaker for Your Frigidaire Fridge

content.text: If using the Reset button or Crush button does not reset the refrigerator, you can perform a hard reset instead. Locate the circuit breaker in your home and look for the switch that corresponds to the refrigerator. Flip the switch to the off position and wait at least 5 minutes to allow the refrigerator to completely power down. Turn the switch back on and allow the fridge to recalibrate itself. You should hear the compressor and fans running, which indicates that power has been restored. Once the fridge is fully powered up you can check to see if it's functioning properly and if there are no longer any error codes or control panel issues.

Knowing when and how to reset your Frigidaire fridge can be a valuable skill for maintaining its optimal performance and extending its lifespan. Whether you're experiencing temperature fluctuations, malfunctioning displays, or other issues, a reset can often provide a simple solution. By following the steps outlined in this guide and understanding the common reasons why a reset may be necessary, you can ensure that your Frigidaire refrigerator continues to keep your food fresh and your kitchen running smoothly. However, if resetting does not resolve the issue, then your fridge may need repair. You can use our model search feature to find genuine OEM Frigidaire refrigerator parts for your appliance.  With proper care and maintenance, your Frigidaire fridge will continue to serve you well for years to come.
